name: AI Simple PDF to Text
description: Provides AI automators and a function-call tool that convert an uploaded PDF to plain text using the pure-PHP smalot/pdfparser library.
project_description:
This project exposes a simple PDF-to-text tool for your string_long or text_long fields, plus a function-call tool usable by AI agents/assistants. It uses smalot/pdfparser behind the scenes, meaning it is completely portable and does not require any external command-line applications (no pdftotext/ghostscript) or services to be installed on your server. It just works.

It is very basic; if you need higher extraction quality we would recommend the Unstructured module.

Post-installation: on a node type set up a file field that accepts PDF, and on the same node type set up a string_long or text_long field. When configuring the text field, turn on AI Automators and pick "Simple PDF to Text".

tool_plugins.label: PDF to Text
tool_plugins.description: Extract text content from PDF documents given a file ID or file location.
